subject: Re: Follow-up: model mix & pricing (post-discovery)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: model mix & pricing (post-discovery)

Hi Sarah — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can get you a formal quote and an SOW draft. TL;DR: we need your confirmed monthly token volumes by model, your target budget range, and any hard constraints on latency/region or private deployment.

Recap of what we heard on the call:
- Primary user flows: customer chat (session-based generation) + semantic search/embeddings for knowledge retrieval + a small reranking step on search results.
- Expected peak concurrency: low-mid (50–200 concurrent users) but spiky during business hours.
- Data residency: US-only for now.

Open asks (can you confirm by EOD Thursday?):
1) Monthly token volumes (approximate) by model type — we typically break this into: chat (generation tokens), embeddings (tokens consumed when creating vectors + any tokenized content per query), and rerank (tokens for scoring):
   - Chat generation tokens / month: suggested placeholder 120M in our example
   - Embeddings tokens / month: suggested placeholder 60M
   - Rerank tokens / month: suggested placeholder 20M
2) Target budget range for inference (monthly): helpful to give a pipe-range (e.g., $200k–$400k/month) or a hard cap.
3) Target unit economics: any target $/1M tokens we should optimize toward? If you don’t have one, we can propose a blended target.

Preliminary pricing notes (for discussion only — I attached a quick quote + token estimate):
- Proposed per-model rough unit costs (these are blended estimates accounting for model class & quantization):
   * Chat generation: $2,500 per 1M tokens
   * Embeddings: $600 per 1M tokens
   * Rerank: $1,800 per 1M tokens
- Example model mix we discussed: Chat 60% / Embeddings 30% / Rerank 10%
- Example total volume: 200M tokens/month => blended cost ~ $1,600 per 1M tokens => est. monthly spend $320,000 (range depends on committed capacity / reserved discounts).

Next steps:
- If you can confirm the numbers above, we’ll produce a formal quote with: reserved capacity options (Dedicated) + hosted incremental pricing + canary rollout plan for the chat model.
- If you have an internal target $/1M tokens, share it and we’ll show how different batch/cache/quantization settings hit that target.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-quote-v1.pdf, tokens-estimate-brightlayer.xlsx

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30-min call if easier.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@brightlayer.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-18T16:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: model mix & pricing (post-discovery)

Thanks Marissa — really helpful recap. A few clarifications below and the numbers we have so far.

Confirmed (estimates):
- Chat generation tokens: ~100–140M / month (varies by feature flags — we can lock to 120M as a working number)
- Embeddings tokens: ~50–70M / month (mostly short documents, vector size per doc small)
- Rerank tokens: ~15–25M / month (applies on search top-N rerank)

Budget: Our finance sponsor asked for a target range of $200k–$350k monthly for inference (including both hosted and reserved pricing options). They prefer reserved + occasional burst capacity if it keeps unit economics predictable.

Target unit economics: They don’t have an absolute $/1M tokens target, but the business owner indicated an internal target to get to "sub-$1,800 per 1M tokens blended" if possible. If you can show a path to that with Dedicated/reserved discounts + caching, that will be compelling.

Constraints: US-only for production data; will need SOC2 evidence and standard IP terms (we can share the vendor compliance checklist if you need it).

Happy to do a follow-up call with finance next week. When can you and Rishi join?

—Sarah
Sarah Patel
Head of Product — Search & AI | BrightLayer
sarah.patel@brightlayer.com

> Hi Sarah — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can get you a formal quote and an SOW draft. TL;DR: we need your confirmed monthly token volumes by model, your target budget range, and any hard constraints on latency/region or private deployment.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-19T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: model mix & pricing (post-discovery)

Thanks for the fast turnaround, Sarah — this is exactly what we need. Based on your confirmed ranges I ran two scenarios and attached the quick math in the spreadsheet:

Scenario A — Baseline (120M chat / 60M embeddings / 20M rerank):
- Blended unit cost (no reserved commit): ~$1,600 / 1M tokens => est. $320,000 / month
- With a 3–6 month reserved commit (Dedicated burst model) we can get to roughly $1,250–$1,400 / 1M tokens depending on model pinning (sustained chat capacity gives biggest leverage).

Scenario B — Aggressive optimization (batching + prefix cache + quantized embeddings):
- If BrightLayer adopts more aggressive caching and moves embeddings to a compact quantized profile we model ~$1,000–$1,200 / 1M tokens blended => est. $200,000–$240,000 / month for the 200M token example. This requires a modest engineering work (instrument a cache layer + warm prefixes for frequent sessions).

Per-model suggested unit prices we would include on the quote (for transparency):
- Chat generation: $2,200 per 1M tokens (reserved scenario)
- Embeddings: $450 per 1M tokens (quantized + reserved)
- Rerank: $1,500 per 1M tokens (reserved)

Next steps I propose:
1) We schedule a 30-min pricing review with your finance sponsor next Tue/Wed (I copied Rishi who will lead the dedicated capacity sizing).
2) We share a formal quote + SOW (attached draft PDF).
3) If you want, we can run a 2-week eval (metered) on Redwood Hosted to validate real token counts and tail latency before committing.

Are you available Tue 5/25 10am PT or Wed 5/26 11am PT for the finance call?

Best,
Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Marcus — please prep a one-page tech note on the caching/quantization work required for the aggressive scenario.

I attached the draft quote and the token estimate spreadsheet we sent. I’ll coordinate the finance call once we have sizing.

Thanks — M.
